basis: Current RPG Maker event pages decoded with liblcf, checked against static passages with unconditional same-layer events treated as walls, and a live official-engine run that excluded the same Toy World exits.

sources.events: Event 61 at (21,86) only travels to map 376 while switch 1445 (block confinement) is on.

Event 82 at (42,173) also needs switch 1445. Doors 102 at (47,200) to map 375 and 61 at (19,211) to map 146 lie behind empty same-layer wall events (for example 106 at (32,218) and 112 at (19,212)); no map 617 entrance reaches them.
Event 40 at (7,7) teleports to map 1 only with debug switch 11.
Developer Room; event 24 asks to return to the debug room only inside a switch 11 branch.
Debug warp menu entered from map 1 and Symbolon's Game of Life room; it has no location name.
Event 2 at (3,2): page 1 is a dummy page; page 2, the menu that leads to map 191, needs debug switch 11.
Unnamed map without inbound graph edges; event 1 enters map 1.
Unnamed map without inbound graph edges; event 96 enters map 1.
Symbolon event 28 at (21,9) is an unconditional touch door to Zodiac Fortress map 143 (22,44).
Night World, Lavender Office, Magic Nexus, Azure Arm Land and Demoscene Tapestry Club: each next exit has one unconditional page reachable from the previous landing.

limitations: Removed Toy World exits can be usable on saves with switch 1445 on or with an effect that passes the wall events; Navbot does not use those.
Edges into debug map 1 and its warp menu 191 are pruned, so neither is reachable; both remain in the source graph.
Source hashes document the inspected map versions; future event changes require another review.

removeEdges.reason: Approach occupied by an invisible wall event
